decision: Diagnostic schema experiment only; no production source/schema edit authorized by this plan. Later implementation/migration requires independent plan reconciliation.
hypothesis: A persistent dependencies(parent,child) covering index may avoid per-query automatic index construction for descendant lookup. Do not assume missing permanent index means repeated full scans. Inspect real EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN and automatic_index pragma first.
arms: Same source; two fresh copies of identical deterministic synthetic ledger per pair. Candidate copy gets CREATE INDEX memory_dependencies_parent ON dependencies(parent,child) outside API timer; separately record one-time index creation wall/file growth. No destructive changes outside temporary fixtures.
seed_graph: Rows n00000.. ascending, 128B content, constant existing created_at, active+verified, scope[]; first chain nodes link i to i-1; remaining nodes form disjoint chains of at most16. Wide case links every nonroot to root. Public add/insert validation tested separately if implementation follows; bulk fixture seeding only controls setup cost, does not claim ingestion speed.
timing: 21 randomized AB/BA pairs seed71406, 3 warmups per arm on separate fresh copies; one complete public API call per sample including path/connection/transaction/all hydration/updates/commit/return. Copy/setup/DDL/equality outside timer symmetrically. No cache answer reuse; correction/add each starts fresh DB. No other parent test/timing while measuring.
gates: Both sparse5000 primary median wall reductions >=20%; each other control regression<=15%. If fail, preserve negative and no source change. Diagnostic pass is not production acceptance or general speed claim.
equality: Impact complete packet exact and DB bytes unchanged per arm. Correct/add stable output, entries/dependencies/document bindings/events equal excluding only newly generated created_at clock fields; record excluded timestamps separately, require nonempty SQLite time format and old timestamps unchanged. Index changes only schema and DB physical bytes; graph input hash must match. Check deterministic invalidation/history/rollback with independent validation before any conclusions.
resources: One local CPU measurement process; 20 minutes, one fixed schema candidate, no GPU/API/model/paid resources, no extra optimization revision. Parent owns files and private lock. Manual plan/result review; no managed ReviewSession, tmux host or automatic trust claim.
prior: prior-search scanned200/partialtrue/errors59 unrelated corpus; knowledge actual hits maxflow capacity network, FAISS exact vectors, HNSW approximate vectors: all assumptions mismatch SQLite dependency reachability. SQLite official optoverview section14 read; previous12-paper/MemForest history only.
independent_validation: Separate plan reviewer before diagnostic, then actual source/harness/data/reference/numerical/measurement/reproducibility review. New data remain pending until review. No downstream code/report publication without acceptance and separate implementation plan.
ddl: Measure sqlite connect + CREATE INDEX + commit + close wall separately, file bytes before/after. Index is sole logical/schema arm difference; source unmodified.
timestamp_rule: Only created_at of entry IDs revision/new-entry and event sequence > seeded max may be normalized; validate SQLite UTC format, store raw; all prior timestamps must stay byte-equal. Normalize only these exact row identities in database snapshots and matching returned new entry.
